endpoints.title: Search for Messages
endpoints.description: This route searches for messages within the given parameters. Bots may only list pinned messages (`pinned: true`): searching text would let a bot read messages its intents hide.
restrictions: Bots get IsBot when options.pinned != Some(true).
Bots may only list pinned messages (`pinned: true`); text search answers IsBot.
